flags.text: Profit compounding faster than sales over 3y (33.4% vs 14.9%): operating leverage

guidance.quote: overall 7%, which I think you are referring to the guidance of Q4 FY27, wherein we are suggesting about INR 25,000 crore of revenue run rate, with a 7% EBITDA. I think we are hopeful that we should be able to hit that mark.

guidance.promise: Get back into 30 percent organic growth in hospitals

claims.claim: Consolidated revenue reached 6304 crore, registering 13 percent year-on-year growth
claims.quote: Consolidated revenue was at INR 6,304 crore, a 13% year-on-year growth.

claims.claim: Healthcare services EBITDA was 781 crore with 24.6 percent margin
claims.quote: Within this, the Healthcare Services EBITDA was at INR 781 crore, registering a growth of 8% year-on-year and Healthcare Services margin remained robust at 24.6%.

claims.claim: Apollo HealthCo reported 17 percent revenue growth to 2661 crore
claims.quote: Moving ahead, Apollo HealthCo reported revenues of INR 2,661 crore marking a 17% year-on-year growth.

claims.claim: Consolidated H1 PAT stood at 910 crore, up by 33 percent
claims.quote: PAT stood at INR 910 crore, up by 33%. This is a strong half year performance

pushback.topic: Organic hospital growth and insurance pricing
pushback.quote: My first question is how to think about organic growth for hospitals. Keeping in light two points; - first is that the Bangladesh impact incrementally will go away, so that will be 1% positive. Secondly, there is lows of news on insurance pricing that hospitals are planning to keep steady for next year. So, keeping both these, could you comment on this and then guide on organic hospital growth for next year?

pushback.topic: New hospital expansion costs and EBITDA margin impact
pushback.quote: My first question is again on hospitals. So, between now and end of FY27, as you indicated, six hospitals coming up. So, I understand '26 Pune will be key addition and the majority will be coming in '27. So, if you can comment a bit on the impact on EBITDA margin trajectory due to the new costs coming up?

pushback.topic: Hospital utilization decline and ALOS limits
pushback.quote: I know you mentioned about the seasonality and the reason why the utilization fell from 73% overall to 69%, and I get it. But I am just trying to look from a forward path perspective, right. ALOS has been consistently declining. This is obviously as we are able to be more efficient in terms of our processes and stuff. But is there a theoretical lower limit where we reach on ALOS?

calls.tone: Confident and optimistic about robust growth, integration benefits, and disciplined expansion plans.

guidance.promise: Digital business cash EBITDA breakeven pushed out by a quarter to Q1 FY27
guidance.quote: forecast about our ability to close it in Q4, given this insurance story, which has sort of pushed us back by around INR17-odd crore... we will be able to close this loop in Q1 of FY '27.
guidance.speaker: Madhivanan B.

guidance.promise: Achieve at least 100 basis points margin expansion in the existing business next year
guidance.quote: At least 100 basis points is the margin expansion, which is possible in the existing business next year.
guidance.speaker: A. Krishnan

guidance.promise: Achieve a run rate of INR 25,000 crore in combined revenues with 7% EBITDA for the combined entity

guidance.speaker: Suneeta Reddy

guidance.promise: Operationalize approximately 1,500 additional operating beds with about half in upcoming fiscal year and balance in early FY28
guidance.quote: These facilities, along with the ramp-up in our recently commissioned Pune hospital, will approximately add 1,500 additional operating beds... We expect to operationalize roughly half of this capacity in the upcoming fiscal year with the balance coming online early FY '28.
guidance.speaker: Suneeta Reddy

claims.claim: Consolidated revenue grew by 17% year-on-year to INR 6,477 crore in Q3 FY26.
claims.quote: On a consolidated basis, revenue grew by 17% year-on-year to INR 6,477 crore.

claims.claim: Consolidated PAT grew by 35% year-on-year to INR 502 crore in Q3 FY26.
claims.quote: we reported a consolidated PAT of INR502 crore in Q3 FY '26, a growth of 35% year-on-year.

claims.claim: Apollo 24/7 added 2 million new users and serves over 46 million users.
claims.quote: Apollo 24/7 added 2 million new users during the quarter and now serves over 46 million users.

claims.claim: Consolidated EBITDA for Q3 FY26 was INR 965 crore, up 27% year-on-year.
claims.quote: Consolidated EBITDA for the quarter was at INR 965 crore, registering a robust growth of 27% year-on-year.

pushback.topic: Digital business GMV drop and revenue moderation
pushback.quote: And secondly, just on the GMV of the Digital business. We have seen a sequential drop in GMV. And in fact, our revenue to GMV ratio also went up. Could you share your thoughts on that?

pushback.topic: New hospital ramp-up costs and headwind impact
pushback.quote: Could you -- last time we discussed about INR150 crore cost headwind coming out of this ramp-up. Any updated thoughts on that?

pushback.topic: Doctor retention and talent poaching risks
pushback.quote: And very recently, we have seen one of the star oncologists in Delhi has been poached by one of your peers. Just trying to understand how you are tackling this issue.

credibility.line: Management achieved revenue targets ahead of schedule and expanded margins, despite delaying digital breakeven by one quarter.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management claimed revenue growth momentum; reported YoY revenue growth accelerated from 10.7% in Sep 2025 to 23.0% in Sep 2026.
Management claimed 35% PAT growth in Q3 FY26; reported PAT for Dec 2025 reached ₹516 crore, growing 36.1% YoY.
Analysts flagged expansion costs and utilization limits; reported EBITDA margin nevertheless improved from 15.0% to 16.0% by Sep 2026.

bull: Revenue growth accelerated for four consecutive quarters, reaching 23.0% YoY in Sep 2026.
FY26 annual revenue reached ₹25,228 crore, achieving the ₹25,000 crore run-rate target ahead of Q4 FY27.
Operating leverage yielded 33.4% 3-year profit compounding while EBITDA margin reached 16.0% in Sep 2026.
bear: Total borrowings expanded significantly from ₹5,333 crore in Mar 2024 to ₹8,149 crore in Sep 2026.
Working capital cycle stretched by 26 days over 2 years, shifting cash cycle from -23 to 3 days.
Digital business breakeven target was deferred to Q1 FY27 due to an unexpected ₹17 crore insurance impact.
watch: EBITDA margin retention at 16.0% in Q3 FY27.
Progress on debt reduction from ₹8,149 crore.
Sustainability of YoY revenue growth above 20%.
